big: Nifty Cement is a snapshot of one slice of the market. Its factsheet answers four quick questions: how many stocks, what is the valuation, who is on top and how concentrated is it.

lines: What does the Nifty Cement track?
The Nifty Cement Index aims to track the performance of stocks from the Nifty Total Market that belong to the ‘Cement & Cement products’ industry. It holds 12 stocks and is rebalanced twice a year.
